description: The committed IPC command allowlist. CI fails when the tauri-specta generated bindings expose a command set different from this list. Additions are deliberate contract changes, never side effects.

notes.note_create: Creates an empty Markdown note at a validated vault-relative path without overwriting an existing file, then refreshes the vault index.
notes.note_write: Contract addition per design decision 100: change-set based writes verified against the expected projection hash, with a conflict variant carrying the current hash and a reconciliation handle, never a silent overwrite.
notes.edit_history_read: Reads one note's reachable durable undo and redo stacks from application data.
notes.edit_history_append: Appends and fsyncs an idempotent edit-history batch before the corresponding note save begins.
notes.edit_history_fence: Appends an external-ingest boundary that makes older edit-history entries unreachable.
notes.edit_history_clear: Physically removes one note's persisted edit-history journal after user confirmation.
notes.vault_tree_refresh: Contract addition per design decision 100: on-demand re-index of the vault tree from current filesystem state, the recovery path for tree staleness after external bulk changes or watcher overflow.
notes.search_query: Contract addition per design decision 100: ranked snippeted full-text search (the decision 79 alpha floor). The index lives in the OS app-data directory, never in the vault; match positions are byte ranges into the snippet so highlighting needs no HTML injection.
notes.tag_catalog: Returns tags from the derived search index with note and occurrence counts for completion ranking.
notes.update_check: Checks the selected stable or beta signed updater manifest and returns only current or available metadata. Installation remains in the updater plugin.
notes.settings_read: Contract addition per design decision 100: reads settings.json from the OS app-config directory per the architecture contract (schema_version, typed known keys, defaults when absent).
notes.settings_path: Returns the resolved settings document path for display in the desktop settings surface.
notes.settings_write: Contract addition per design decision 100: whole-document settings write with validation; unknown keys already in the file are preserved internally.
notes.vault_config_read: Contract addition per design decision 100: read-only access to the recognized Obsidian configuration files (app.json, types.json) in the vault's .obsidian directory, the single sanctioned read path into an otherwise excluded directory; absent or malformed files degrade to defaults.
notes.vault_file_read: Read-only access to indexed regular files for registered render-only views. The command never creates note editing, reconciliation, or search-index state.
notes.zoom_set: Validates, persists, and applies one application zoom percentage to every webview window.
notes.window_warmup: Lets Linux WebKit commit an offscreen frame without exposing the startup window.
notes.window_ready: Applies persisted zoom and reveals a hidden or warmed window after the frontend reports its first painted frame.
notes.file_open_resolve: Resolves an operating-system file-open path to a known vault or the file's containing folder.
notes.open_files_take: Drains file-open paths queued by argv, second-instance forwarding, or native open-file events.
notes.plugin:dialog|confirm: Shows the destructive-action confirmation before clearing one note's edit history.
notes.plugin:opener|open_url: Opens validated HTTP and HTTPS links in the system browser. The capability excludes paths and every other URL scheme.
